comments.story: Ask HN: How would a high schooler find CS mentor?
comments.why: One resource among many for a high schooler to learn CS
comments.text: Make the entire Internet your mentor. It's filled with information and answers to all sorts of questions. Look at some programming tutorials such as codecademy. Maybe find some books on computer architecture, learn about mathematics that might apply to computer scientists. Here are some links to get you started. [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] Also, learn to use YouTube to search for answers. Check this video out. [VIDEO]
